findings.summary: The Quick Search trigger is rendered as an anchor with button behavior instead of a native button.
findings.consequence: The component has to recreate native button keyboard behavior manually, and tests now encode the non-native anchor shape, making future accessibility regressions easier to miss.
findings.evidence: The owned template starts an `<a>` element at line 128, then assigns `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, click handling, and explicit Enter/Space key handlers on lines 130-136. The control does not navigate; it only opens `LazyQuickSearch` in the same list item. `test/ssr/quick-search.spec.ts` asserts this exact anchor+role output rather than a native button.
findings.recommendation: Render this control as `<button type="button" ref="quickSearchTrigger" class="quick-search-trigger" title="Snabbkommando: 's'" @click="openQuickSearch">Snabbsökning</button>` and remove the manual tabindex and Enter/Space handlers; keep the existing `.mainnav .quick-search-trigger` reset styles.
